name: lpqi_spad1_mpd
label: LPQI MPD single-pixel 50 um SPAD (back-up)
sources: F. Prada (LPQI PI), email to P. Nugent 2026-10-07: sensor data for both LPQI-Pathfinder detectors and the filter set
notes: Micro Photon Devices 50 um single-pixel SPAD module: PDE 50 % at 550 nm, taken as a flat 30 % over 400-700 nm (assumed).
Timing 35 ps FWHM above 470 nm; 250-300 ps FWHM at 400 nm -- hbtsim has one jitter per detector, so the blue filter uses detectors/lpqi_spad1_mpd_blue (275 ps).
Dead time 55 ns (specifications); dark counts 50 cps (as offered); one pixel takes the whole seeing disk (< 2 arcsec).
Time-tag link ceiling UNKNOWN (left open: no ceiling applied); to be supplied by the LPQI team.
